_note: Corrections to the Overture data, keyed by church index (position in data/points.txt). Fields: web = website URL; sv = Street View panorama to show, with heading/pitch/fov, when the nearest one faces the wrong side; dup = index of the church this pin repeats (the pin is hidden and old links open that one); hide = not a church (an office), taken off the globe. Applied by the page and by scripts/web. Most dup/hide entries (2026-11-02) were found by a script: similar names a short walk apart, and diocese or bishop office names. 2026-11-03 (Dev, OpenStreetMap switch): a pin on the same OpenStreetMap church as a better-named pin with a similar name is marked dup of it.
